steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to the fresh pipeline; verify baseline: both trigger options (Chat Message, Webhook) present and ENABLED
Step 2 — Add a Printer node (unconnected); verify it exists on canvas
Step 3 — WITHOUT saving, open the Trigger dropdown; verify the restriction does NOT apply yet
Step 5 — Open the Trigger dropdown again; verify Webhook is DISABLED in place and Chat Message stays selectable, immediately (no reload needed) AND after a reload
Step 6 — Remove Printer, add a HITL node instead; Save; verify the same restriction applies
